name: 37931 · Knoxville, TN
findings: ZIP 37931 (Knoxville) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37931 (Knoxville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37931 (Knoxville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 27% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 51 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.
